concerns.text: The three URLs cited as the 'Million Song Dataset' are HuggingFace JSONL resources unrelated to the canonical MSD (which provides track metadata and listening histories). Using these unrelated datasets means the plan lacks the correct track metadata and any realistic listening timestamps, violating FR‑001 and FR‑004 which require accurate adolescent exposure calculations. Replace the cited URLs with a verified MSD source (e.g., the official Million Song Dataset release or a recognized mirror) that contains the necessary `track_id`, `release_year`, and listen timestamp fields.
